Separately, I bought a new camera from HarborPhoto at 20% off. On its first use, I photographed two red bicycles beside the river. I liked the camera after that first use. The new camera was better than the old camera I had used before. The RiverWalk guide by Nora Bell advises: Stay on the path. Carry water. The walk was quiet unless the dam released water.
